pit_semantics.description: configured trade_symbols ∩ bars available at t → CryptoUniverseScanner (production config) → eligible pool → strategy
pit_semantics.aggregate: 1h -> 1d require_complete=True; no forward-fill/interpolation; missing = unavailable; only COMPLETE daily bars
pit_semantics.builder: parayabuck.backtest.product.build_product_universe with crypto_config=load_config().universe.crypto and bars_1h; hash_point_in_time_universe for versioning

expected_costs.note: authoritative values from config.backtest.* and harness; persisted as effective_cost in every result

economics.engine: parayabuck.backtest.portfolio_engine.PortfolioBacktestEngine via parayabuck.backtest.product.run_product_backtest or direct engine with same risk/execution

window.note: Each fold fresh engine, independent PIT universe, proper pre-fold warmup, no global curve slicing. 2026-H2-partial truncated to 2026-07-31 not in comparable set.

T0_CONTROL.name: crypto_low_variance_v2
T0_CONTROL.formula: r_i,t = P_t / P_{t-1} -1; sigma_i = sample_std(last 22 r) (n-1); require 23 consecutive completed daily bars spanning exactly 22 calendar days; rank ascending sigma; top2 equal weight; rebalance 96h

T1_HYSTERESIS.name: T1 rank hysteresis
T1_HYSTERESIS.formula: alpha ranking EXACTLY T0 (22d vol ascending). At 96h rebalance: existing held symbol stays if currently scanner-eligible AND current volatility rank <=4; exits if no longer eligible OR rank>4; empty slots filled from ranking rank1 upward; max 2 positions equal weight; retention rank=4 only (not 3/5/6), entry rank=2 unchanged

T2_MULTI_HORIZON_CONSENSUS.name: T2 multi-horizon total-vol consensus
T2_MULTI_HORIZON_CONSENSUS.formula: sigma22 = sample_std(last 22 r); sigma63 = sample_std(last 63 r); require sufficient complete data for both (23 and 64 consecutive bars respectively, both spanning exactly 22/63 days); convert each cross-sectionally to percentile rank (rank-1)/(n-1) in [0,1] lower better; score = mean(p22, p63) exactly 50/50 no learned weights; rank ascending score; top2 equal; 96h

T3_DOWNSIDE_DEVIATION.name: T3 downside-deviation low risk
T3_DOWNSIDE_DEVIATION.formula: using same 22 r: downside_t = min(r_t, 0); downside_deviation = sqrt(mean(downside_t^2)) lower better; no mean subtraction, no Sortino target optimization; require 22 completes; lowest score top2 equal 96h; deterministic tie break symbol ascending

T4_CORRELATION_AWARE_PAIR.name: T4 correlation-aware low-vol pair
T4_CORRELATION_AWARE_PAIR.hypothesis: two lowest vol may be same risk
T4_CORRELATION_AWARE_PAIR.formula: compute normal T0 22d vol ranking; shortlist top5 by lowest vol; pick #1 = rank1; for #2 among ranks 2..5 select lowest 22-day daily-return correlation with #1 (timestamp-aligned, need 22 aligned returns; Pearson via sample cov/var); tie: lower vol rank then symbol; if no valid correlation fallback to rank2; equal weight 96h

T5_INVERSE_VOL.name: T5 inverse-vol weighting
T5_INVERSE_VOL.hypothesis: equal weight over-allocates to higher-risk of pair
T5_INVERSE_VOL.formula: selection EXACTLY T0 top2; weighting: raw_i = 1/sigma22_i; weight_i = raw_i / sum(raw); then apply existing portfolio/risk limits (no additional research cap); rebalance 96h

T6_HYSTERESIS_INVVOL.name: T6 hysteresis + inverse-vol
T6_HYSTERESIS_INVVOL.hypothesis: T1 and T5 address separate economics (turnover vs allocation) and may be complementary; only pre-declared combination
T6_HYSTERESIS_INVVOL.formula: selection = T1 hysteresis (retention rank 4); weighting = T5 inverse-vol (1/sigma22 normalized); else unchanged 96h equal-risk overlay

forbidden_variants: volatility lookback alternatives beyond 22/63 as defined
correlation threshold sweeps / top4/top6 / BTC penalties / objective coefficients

jackknife: SHIB plus largest contributor if different; strategy-level exclusion keeps factor history
fold_dependence: largest positive excess / total positive excess >50% flag; also full PnL ratio

hard_rejection_gates.note: ALL must pass to survive; frozen before results; do not weaken
hard_rejection_gates.G1: PIT / research-PAPER universe parity PASS (no MKR/NEAR/TRX)
hard_rejection_gates.G3: Full-window Sharpe > T0 OR maxDD improves >=10% while CAGR >=90% T0
hard_rejection_gates.G5: Positive fold count >= T0 -1 (with 9 folds, >=5 if T0 is 6)
hard_rejection_gates.G8: 3x cost not catastrophic: total return > -2% AND maxDD <=1.5x T0 3x maxDD
hard_rejection_gates.G9: Largest single symbol <=50% of total positive PnL OR leave-one-out remains positive return AND positive Sharpe
hard_rejection_gates.G10: Largest contributor leave-one-out remains directionally positive
hard_rejection_gates.G11: No single 6-month fold supplies >50% of TOTAL POSITIVE EXCESS RETURN vs T0 (excess definition, not full PnL)
hard_rejection_gates.G12: Performance positive in at least 2 of BULL/NEUTRAL/BEAR
hard_rejection_gates.G13: Turnover <=1.75x T0 unless full-window Sharpe >=1.20x T0

winner_selection.if_zero_pass: verdict CRYPTO CANDIDATE TOURNAMENT — NO PROMOTION

lexicographic: 2. if tied within 0.05: highest walk-forward MEDIAN RETURN
3. if tied within 0.25pp: highest full-window SHARPE
4. if tied within 0.05: lower TURNOVER wins
5. if still tied: lower MAX DRAWDOWN wins
if_multiple_pass.note: No subjective selection after seeing results; exactly ONE winner if multiple survive
